title: .transom.yaml
description: How transom treats renders sent from this repo. Every key is optional; a flag on `transom post` beats the file.

zone.description: The zone renders from this repo land in. Defaults to the repo's directory name.

show.description: `wall` sends to the wall. `preview` makes `transom post` open the file locally instead, and nothing reaches the wall.

defaults.description: What a send from this repo gets when it does not say.

ttl.description: How long a card lives, as `--ttl` takes it: `30m`, `2h`, `1d`, or a bare number of seconds.

apps.description: Offered as "Open in …" in the lightbox, as `--app` takes them. A path is relative to the repo root.

attention.description: How much a card from this repo may ask for.

loudest.description: The highest level a send may ask for. A higher `--attention` is lowered to this.

sound.description: `false` keeps a card's attention level but never plays its sound.

marks.description: Marks drawn on a card in the lightbox.

unsent.description: What happens to marks when the session that sent the card is gone. `keep` holds them on the card until they are sent or thrown away.
